usageNotes: Use this to inspect the configuration of a specific SMTP notification endpoint by its config ID — useful before updating it or verifying delivery settings. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit on /mapping/notifications; note that SMTP credentials (password) are never returned, only the username. The response includes a 'digest' field that should be passed to any subsequent update call to guard against concurrent modifications.
tips: The 'digest' in the response is a config-file hash — pass it to the corresponding update operation to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.
If 'disable' is true in the response, notifications will not be sent through this endpoint even if it is referenced by active notification rules.
SMTP passwords are write-only in Proxmox; this endpoint will never reveal them — verify authentication by testing the endpoint via the UI or a separate test notification.
Default TLS mode is 'tls' (implicit TLS, port 465); if the server requires STARTTLS, confirm 'mode' is 'starttls' and 'port' is 587.
